name: Mizokuchi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Mizokuchi town emblem in maroon: a stylised device of a curved stroke and a winged bar, like a bird.
history: Flag of the former town of Mizokuchi in Tottori Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-01-01.

features.role: Mizokuchi town emblem — a stylised device of a curved stroke and a winged bar, like a bird
